# OpenHands Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native OpenHands configuration. The main output is `.openhands/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - openhands
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - openhands:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                                     |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                                    |
| **Main output**   | `.openhands/rules/project.md`             |
| **Dot directory** | `.openhands/`                             |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.openhands/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | No                                        |
| **Commands**      | No                                        |
| **Local files**   | No                                        |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                                | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.openhands/rules/project.md`       | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.openhands/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                                                       |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .openhands/rules/project.md file                                                      |
| `multifile`      | .openhands/rules/project.md + .openhands/mcp_config.toml (skills via full mode)              |
| `full` (default) | .openhands/rules/project.md + .openhands/skills/<name>/SKILL.md + .openhands/mcp_config.toml |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                             |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | `.openhands/mcp_config.toml` (toml) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported                       |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
